VIVA RRQ

Rex Regum Qeon is a Southeast Asian esports organisation built on a decade-long commitment to competitive excellence, professionalism, and sustainable growth. Founded in 2013, RRQ has grown from a single lineup into a multi-division team competing at the highest level across multiple titles and regions, developing generations of elite players along the way. Defined by discipline, teamwork, and resilience through both victories and setbacks, Rex Regum Qeon focuses on building a lasting legacy that inspires fans, empowers talent, and strengthens the wider esports ecosystem.
